paper.title: You Only Look at Screens: Multimodal Chain-of-Action Agents
paper.central_claim: Auto-GUI is a multimodal agent that acts directly on screens without environment parsing or app-specific APIs; a chain-of-action technique (previous action history + predicted future action plan) improves action decisions; it achieves state-of-the-art AITW results (90% action-type accuracy, 74% action success) with sub-second inference.
paper.scope_as_measured: Offline screen-wise action matching on the five AITW subsets (episode-wise 80/10/10 split), 60M–700M seq2seq models with frozen BLIP-2 features, single runs.

missing_sections: Figures 1–11 image-only (Figure 5 cross-subset transfer values, Figure 3 chain-length sweep, Figure 4 category accuracies).

signatures.information: current screenshot as frozen BLIP-2 feature; goal; up to 8 previous action tuples (no previous screenshots)
signatures.operation: single-head attention + gated fusion into T5 encoder; decode up to 4 future action types then current action with normalised coordinates
signatures.output: action type, touch/lift point, typed text
signatures.conditions: supervised AITW demonstrations; history = executed/gold action log
signatures.claimed_effect: higher matching accuracy, no parser/API, <1 s inference
signatures.failure_boundary: click region and scroll direction errors dominate; unified model weaker on app-centred subsets (O13)

assessment.author_claim_preserved: state-of-the-art autonomous GUI agent interacting directly with screens; 90% action type, 74% action success
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Under offline AITW matching, a <1B seq2seq policy with a projected frozen image feature, action-text history and a predicted action-type plan reaches 74.3 overall (≈1 point above copied BC-history, lower on two subsets) with sub-second model inference; the joint chain-of-action ablation (−5.7) is supported, the history-vs-plan split is contradictory, and parsed descriptions still help.
unresolved: Table 3 vs Table 9 history/plan label swap (paper-internal contradiction)

G.reason: Decided for son55. Deployment/API limitation is real, but the accuracy bottleneck (parse error propagation, O12) is asserted not measured and is weakened by the paper’s own Table 10 (O03); BC-history already uses history, so the residue over the nearest neighbour is under-delimited.

M.reason: Decided for son55. Mechanism specified, coordinate normalisation reasoned; but the screen enters as a single pooled 1×d_s feature (O09) with no account of how fine click localisation is achieved, and the causal story for an action-type-only future plan is thin.

X.reason: Both 3; confirmed. Training details, schema, normalisation, chain lengths given; input resolution, feature shape and plan use at inference under-specified; size figures inconsistent (60/200/700M vs 220/770M).

E.measurement.reason: Both 1; confirmed. Offline matcher with 14% tolerance (O05) and only a cited correlation (O06); LLM baselines scored with a different rule; no executed outcome for an autonomy claim.

E.causality.reason: Decided for son55. Same-model ablations exist and the joint chain-of-action effect is consistent across tables (68.53); attribution between halves is contradictory (O01/O02) and LLM baselines are confounded (1% data, O07), so 2 rather than 1.

E.holdout.reason: Both 1; confirmed. Random episode split (O04) with repeated instructions/apps; one dataset; cross-subset transfer image-only.

E.statistics.reason: Both 1; confirmed. Single runs; ~1-point headline margin without variance; per-subset/category breakdowns.

E.cost.reason: Decided for sol. Actual inference time/memory and training hours are measured (O10), but budget fairness is weak: Llama-2 fine-tuned on 1% of data (O07), unified model on 10% GoogleApps (O08), copied BC numbers with unknown budget (O11), timing not end-to-end. Consistent with AutoDroid (3) whose cost comparisons are same-backbone.
